question: A sum of money was invested at simple interest at a certain rate for 9 years. Had it been invested at an 8% per annum higher rate, it would have fetched ₹7,992 more. Find the principal.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Extra interest rate = 8% per annum

Total time = 9 years

Total percentage increase in interest = 9 × 8% = 72%

This 72% of Principal = ₹7,992

Principal = (7,992 ÷ 72) × 100 = 111 × 100 = ₹11,100

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time (T) = 9 years

Increase in Rate (Rdᵢff) = 8%

Extra Interest fetched = ₹7,992

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Difference in SI = (P × Rdᵢff × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8603232686d852968687eeca1fcdd8fa72a42f2f8e72d76b1c15201adb1e1d8d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 7,992 = (P × 8 × 9) ÷ 100

⇒ 7,992 = (P × 72) ÷ 100

⇒ P = (7,992 × 100) ÷ 72

⇒ P = 111 × 100

⇒ P = ₹11,100

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI) Properties

Simple interest is calculated only on the principal amount. The interest earned remains the same every year if the rate and principal are constant.

Rate Change Impact

If the rate increases by r% for t years, the total interest increase is simply P × r × t ÷ 100.

Amount Calculation

The total amount (A) after T years is given by A = P + SI = P(1 + RT ÷ 100).
